preset.text: Anger Management uses 6 colored suits (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple) numbered 0-15, plus 16 special Action cards.
Each round, you'll look at your hand and predict EXACTLY how many tricks you'll win. Bid wisely!

The game follows standard trick-taking rules: you MUST follow the lead suit if you can.

HOWEVER, you may play an Action Card at any time, even if you hold the lead suit!

Blind Anger: Becomes a rank 16 of any color you choose.
Change Trump: Randomly changes the current trump suit.
No Trump: Erases the trump suit completely.
Plus 5/Minus 5: Adds +5 or -5 points to whoever wins the trick!

You gain +1 point for every trick you win.

If you hit your bid EXACTLY, you get +10 points. If you miss your bid, you lose -5 points.
